items.topic: Stop using blocking loops in FastAPI (asyncio.gather)
items.script: Stop awaiting requests one by one in FastAPI. Asyncio gather fires them all at the same time.

code.snippet:
@app.get("/feed")
async def feed():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        # slow: for u in URLS: await client.get(u)
        # fast: every request at the same time
        res = await asyncio.gather(
            *(client.get(u) for u in URLS)
        )
    return [r.json() for r in res]

items.caption: One asyncio.gather and your FastAPI endpoint stops waiting in line 🏎️

storyboard.narration: A loop runs three requests in three seconds. Gather runs them together in one.
Just wrap the calls in asyncio gather.

items.script: A power of two has exactly one set bit. Subtract one and every bit below it flips. AND them together and you get zero. Six fails the test.

items.topic: Reverse a linked list in place, O(1) space
items.script: Keep three pointers: previous, current and next. Flip one arrow per step, then move everything forward. When current hits null, previous is your new head.

code.snippet:
def reverse(head):
    prev, curr = None, head
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev, curr = curr, nxt
    return prev

items.caption: Reverse a linked list in place, O(1) space 🧠

items.topic: Find the duplicate number in O(1) space (Floyd's cycle detection)
items.script: Treat every value as a pointer to the next index. The duplicate creates a cycle. Move slow one step and fast two steps until they meet, then reset slow and walk both to the cycle entrance.
